alerts.title: Viral load monitoring interval and DSD eligibility need review
alerts.message: Guideline states patients on two NRTIs plus DTG should have viral load checked every 6 months, and may reduce to 12-monthly only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for more than 1 year with reliable adherence. Patient's last viral load was 20 copies/mL on 2025-09-15 (129 days before visit), and the prior value was 30 copies/mL on 2024-09-15 (494 days before visit), so the next VL is due around 2026-03-15. Viral suppression appears sustained, but the record does not document the 6-monthly interval being met in the intervening period, and the clinician's note of discussing DSD eligibility does not document whether the criteria were formally assessed.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm viral load is scheduled by 2026-03-15 at the 6-month interval. Only consider reducing to 12-monthly after confirming sustained VL below 50 copies/mL for over 1 year and reliable adherence, and document this assessment.
